messages:
nina: Quick FYI — after routing 10% traffic to q4b-int4-v2 for the new canary, overall Rouge-L dropped ~6% on our summarization suite and we’re seeing a higher hallucination rate on >2k token contexts. posting a tiny repro and 3 representative failures below. @sam @elaine can you eyeball?

sam: Ugh. Can you paste the eval command you used and the exact model tag?

nina: Eval command: ```python
# run eval
run_eval(model='q4b-int4-v2', suite='long_summ_v2', batch_size=8, max_tokens=2048)
```
Model tag = q4b-int4-v2. Logs attached: eval_metrics.json snippet shows rouge_l -6.1, hallucination_rate +9.2pp.

diego: Any change in tokenization or postproc? Also which kernel (cuda/cuquant?) was used for the canary nodes?

nina: No tokenizer change. Canary nodes used the new int4 kernel built last week (kernel v3.2).

elaine: Can you drop 8–12 failing prompts here? I’ll spin up a tiny golden augmentation batch and route to labelers. We should prioritize code/multi-turn examples which are regressing.

nina: Pasting 3 examples inline (redacted):
1) "Summarize this codebase and highlight risky assumptions" -> model invents nonexistent API in step 3
2) multi-turn chat about product spec where it hallucinates earlier decisions
3) long meeting notes (3.5k tokens) where it adds fabrications as facts

lab-bot: Assigned 24 items to @labeler-team for golden review. ETA 36h. :hammer_and_wrench:

mike: If we can’t triage quick, we should rollback the canary. This looks like a quality regression that will hit customers. :exclamation:

rachel: Short-term mitigation: route >2k-token requests to baseline float model and keep <=2k on q4b. We can implement a routing rule in the console by tomorrow. That buys us time for a proper golden refresh. :thumbsup:

sam: For debugging: can we repro with quant flags off (same model weights but run as fp16) to confirm quant kernel is the culprit? If yes, file a quant-bisect ticket with perf logs.

nina: Good call — starting an isolated run now. Also uploading a small set (N=50) of the failing long-context prompts to /mnt/curation/q4b_regression_samples.json

diego: If kernel v3.2 is the suspect, we may be able to tweak kernel tiling or KV-cache packing. I’ll try a dev build with older packing and run the N=50 suite.

elaine: Planning for golden update: add the 50 failing long-context samples + 200 borderline paraphrases from the seedbank, then run dedupe and provenance check. We also need a label schema update: add field "hallucinated_fact_span" and an explicit severity tag.

mike: +1 on schema. Also propose a short canary rollback now so customer-facing traffic isn’t impacted.

nina: Agreed. Plan: 1) rollback canary to q4b-int4-v1 (immediate) 2) create golden batch (50 failing + 200 borderline) assigned to labelers via lab-bot 3) run fp16 vs int4 bisect and kernel v3.1 vs v3.2 tests 4) re-eval and decide next canary ~48h.

deply-bot: (simulated) Deploy job queued: revert-canary-q4b-int4-v1. Triggered by nina.

rachel: I’ll implement routing rule for >2k to baseline and notify support to watch related tickets.

sam: I’ll own the bisect ticket and link kernel perf traces + eval diffs. Diego take kernel investigation. Elaine own golden & labeling schema. Nina coordinate final decision after results.

nina: Thanks all — marking this P0 for the day. Please ping in this thread with any blockers or if you need extra label capacity. :eyes:
